title: Population is bounded perturbation of hand-authored seeds; not empirically grounded
basis: Population now anchored to 56 GENUINE paired real records (SoilGrids soil + NASA POWER climate), verified paired, harmonisation byte-exact; authored shared-factor covariance disabled in config+code. Residual: only 56 effective locations (112 fields = 56 x ~2 synthetic clones), GB-wide scatter (incl. Wales/Scotland uplands) with no arable land-use filter, not a representative UK-arable sample. Real grounding exists but is a small non-representative pilot.

Verified in effect_ml.py and effect_only_dataset.csv (target_name set contains only delta_* effects). Circularity mechanism removed from the reported skill claim.

title: No global sensitivity, no calibration, no external multi-decade validation
basis: All three now EXIST: (i) Morris+Sobol global sensitivity over a 56-location population; (ii) held-out Hoosfield grid calibration; (iii) uncalibrated 1852-1998 Hoosfield multi-decade validation. BUT quality is limited: Sobol is underpowered (N=32, PRNG sampler, 25% negative first-order indices) and its 'convergence' (0.760) is nested-subsample self-consistency not true convergence; calibration hits a parameter boundary (fym=1.10 capped); Hoosfield FYM/cessation still fails. Present but not yet adequate.

title: Synthetic generator covariance is designed, not estimated
basis: Authored shared Gaussian soil factor genuinely DISABLED (soil_shared_factor_sd=0, bulk coeff=0 in config, shared=0 in generator.py); observable covariance now inherited from 56 real empirical anchors. Residual: some observable couplings (clay_shift, SOC) remain hand-imposed, correlations are attenuated (max delta 0.16), no covariance matrix is explicitly estimated-and-sampled, and the 'empirically_estimated' flag is a hardcoded label; two shipped docs contradict each other on this. Core fix real; 'estimated' claim overstated.
